title: Storage
description: Storage trends: used/free per disk, forecast, size per media category, retention. Docker/grafana/README.md 'Storage trends'.

panels.title: beefy SSD
panels.description: Both SSDs of beefy's hot tier (downloads land here; the nightly mover keeps it at or below 70 % by moving titles to the HDD, from 80 % mergerfs sends new downloads to the HDD). Source: homelab:storage_* (rules/storage-trends.yml).

panels.title: beefy HDD
panels.description: beefy's archive HDD (imports stop at 90 %). Source: homelab:storage_* (rules/storage-trends.yml).

panels.title: Audiobook disk (fastpi)
panels.description: fastpi's /mnt/seagate-black: audiobooks and podcasts. Used and free as df counts them (ext4 reserve left out). Source: homelab:storage_* (rules/storage-trends.yml).

panels.title: Total combined
panels.description: beefy SSD + HDD + fastpi audiobook disk. Source: homelab:storage_* (rules/storage-trends.yml).

panels.title: Full in ~ (estimate)
panels.description: Days until the disk is full if it keeps filling like in the last 30 days: where predict_linear's line of free space reaches 0 (1 h steps). An estimate: one big download, the nightly mover or a delete changes it. beefy SSD: the mover moves titles to the HDD from 70 %, so a full SSD means the HDD takes the downloads.

panels.title: Growth per month (estimate)
panels.description: How much more is used per 30 days at the pace of the last 30 days (negative: shrinking). Same fit as "Full in".

panels.title: Used vs size per disk (links on top: 30 / 90 / 365 days)
beefy SSD
panels.description: Both SSDs of beefy's hot tier (downloads land here; the nightly mover keeps it at or below 70 % by moving titles to the HDD, from 80 % mergerfs sends new downloads to the HDD). Dashed line: size.

panels.title: beefy HDD
panels.description: beefy's archive HDD (imports stop at 90 %). Dashed line: size.

panels.title: Audiobook disk (fastpi)
panels.description: fastpi's /mnt/seagate-black: audiobooks and podcasts. Used and free as df counts them (ext4 reserve left out). Dashed line: size.

panels.title: Total combined
panels.description: beefy SSD + HDD + fastpi audiobook disk. Dashed line: size.

panels.title: Size per category (stacked)
panels.description: Films and series from beefy's Radarr/Sonarr file records (beefy_library_bytes, hourly while beefy is awake, kept while it sleeps); quality 4K HDR = 2160p with HDR/Dolby Vision, 720p/other = everything below 1080p. Audiobooks, podcasts, ebooks, music: folder sizes on fastpi (fastpi_library_bytes, daily 05:17). A category without a library has no line.

panels.title: Size now
panels.description: Last value per category; ebooks and music show "no library yet" until a folder for them is listed in library-exporter/libraries.toml and exists.

panels.title: Titles now
panels.description: Films: one per film. Series: one per series, counted under the quality holding most of its bytes. Audiobooks/podcasts: folders holding files (CD/Disc folders count as one).

panels.title: Kept forever
panels.description: Titles the retention rules keep (old, niche, highly rated, Keep forever choices, protected): beefy_retention_bytes{state="keep"}.

panels.title: Temporary (would be freed)
panels.description: Titles the rules would delete once their time is up: the space deletion frees over time. Deletion is off while retention runs in observe mode.

panels.title: Leaving within 7 days
panels.description: Temporary titles whose delete date is at most 7 days away.
